fusions.name: Cap Burst
fusions.desc: A puff of spores deals 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and makes each [Diseased] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target (max +50%).

fusions.name: Rot Root
fusions.desc: A sting that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. It deals 9 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelial Mend
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you and every ally, and restores 8 health to each.

fusions.name: Compost Cycle
fusions.desc: When a condition you inflicted expires, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
